fees.notes: Unverified: KLUST programme pages state 'Looking for fee information? Ask us' and only a processing fee is published for international applicants (checked 2026-09-18). Previous third-party/estimated value removed.

requirements.general: Any one of these: STPM: Minimum 2 Principal Passes and a credit in SPM English. A-Level: Minimum 2 Principle Passes and a credit in O-Level English. UEC: Minimum 5Bs (including English). Diploma / HND: Minimum CGPA of 2.00. Foundation / Matriculation: Minimum CGPA of 2.00. SAM / HSC / AUSMAT: TER/UAI average 60% or higher in 5 subjects. CPU / CIMP: Average of 60% or higher in 6 subjects. IB:  26 points or higher based on 6 subjects. Other Qualifications: As recognised by the Senate of IUKL as equivalent to STPM. Note: The credit requirement of English at SPM level can be waived should the grade obtained at STPM/STAM level or its equivalent is higher. ENGLISH LANGUAGE REQUIREMENT: IELTS - 6 TOEFL (PBT) - 537 TOEFL (IBT) - 46 PTE - 59 MUET - BAND 4 Cambridge English - 169
